integrity.claim_scope: Exact algebraic characterization of the fractional batch conformal e-prediction score set and a worst-case one-step wealth-reserve frontier.
integrity.primary_msc_basis: MSC2020 62L10 is 'Sequential statistical analysis'; the claim concerns an anytime-valid sequential statistical prediction process.
integrity.proof_basis: Direct monotonicity and rational-inequality algebra; deterministic checker is supplementary.
integrity.source_date_basis: The motivating primary source arXiv:2503.13050 was first submitted 2025-03-17.

limitations: One-step conditional theorem; no claim of optimality for a multi-step expected-size objective.
Worst-case reserve over all positive current scores can be conservative under a known score distribution.
Literature inspection supports non-implication by checked sources but cannot establish exhaustive historical priority.
title: Sharp reserve–efficiency frontier for fractional batch conformal e-prediction
